# Roadmap: Frontend Developer

A step-by-step plan to become a Frontend Developer, built from 9 topics in your notes. Builds the user interface people see and click in the browser.

> **Draft, generated from your notes.** Every item links to the note it comes from. The order of topics is a suggestion; review and adjust it.

## The role

- **What they do:** Builds the user interface people see and click in the browser.
- **Typical experience to be hired:** 0+ yrs
- **Technical skills:** Responsive design, Accessibility (WCAG), State management, Web performance (Core Web Vitals), REST/GraphQL integration, Component design, Browser security (XSS, CORS), Unit & E2E testing, SEO basics, Cross-browser testing
- **Source:** [IT Roles & Terminology Atlas](../../IT_Roles_Terminology_Atlas/IT_Roles_Terminology_Atlas.md), line 358
